raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner used the directors’ ages at their films’ release to infer who was born earlier and then concluded incorrectly. Despite retrieving correct birth years (Lucio Fulci 1927; H. Bruce Humberstone 1901), they claimed Fulci’s film had the earlier-born director. The correct comparison of birth years shows Humberstone (1901) was born earlier, so the correct film is Charlie Chan in Honolulu.
